worklogs.title: Registered work
worklogs.explainer: Manual human work records, separate from planned estimates, machine runtime and billing. Totals include active records only.
worklogs.manual_help: Choose a human resource and task, then enter the date and minutes worked. Nothing is recorded until you save.
worklogs.correction_help: Save a new revision with a reason. The original record remains in history. To change the human resource, void this record and register a new one.
worklogs.void_help: Voiding removes this record from active totals. Its contents and all revisions remain available in history.
worklogs.reason_hint: Required, up to 200 characters. Explain the correction or void.
worklogs.choose_task_help: Choose a current task to confirm its version.
worklogs.immutable_resource: The human resource stays the same across revisions.
worklogs.acknowledge: I confirm this work is being recorded or changed on behalf of the selected person.
worklogs.read_only: Current permission does not allow this action. No work will be recorded.
worklogs.access_changed: Access has changed. Protected work records have been cleared. Refresh to check your current access.
worklogs.original_pending: The original save still needs confirmation. Restore its result before editing or leaving this form.
worklogs.task_required: Choose a current task and confirm its version.
worklogs.minutes_invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1,440.
worklogs.note_invalid: Keep the work note within 200 valid characters.
worklogs.reason_invalid: Enter a reason within 200 valid characters.
worklogs.on_behalf_denied: Current permission does not allow recording work for another person.
worklogs.ack_required: Confirm that you are acting on behalf of the selected person.
worklogs.empty_help: Only explicitly saved human work appears here. Estimates and execution do not create work records.
worklogs.page_scope: {{loaded}} records on this page / {{total}} matching records. Totals cover all matching records.
worklogs.stale_scope: Work records changed while paging. Refresh from the first page for a consistent view.
worklogs.invalid_week: Choose a Monday with a valid calendar date. The current week has been kept.
worklogs.week_blocked: Finish or discard the current draft before changing weeks.
worklogs.history_help: Each saved revision is retained. History is read only and does not add to active totals.
worklogs.history_scope: {{loaded}} revisions on this page / {{total}} retained revisions.
worklogs.on_behalf_recorded: Explicitly confirmed on behalf of another person
